## Complete Codebase Inventory: JaimeIbrahim Project

I've completed a thorough exploration of the JaimeIbrahim portfolio project. Here's a structured summary of the entire route architecture and component system:

---

### ROUTES STRUCTURE

#### 1. **Root Layout** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\app\layout.tsx`)
- **Wraps:** All routes globally
- **Renders:**
  - Skip link accessibility anchor
  - `GridLines` (animated structural grid, fixed background)
  - `ScrollProgress` (2px progress bar at top)
  - `Nav` (fixed navigation)
  - `main#main-content` with children
  - `Footer` (with CTA, weather, socials)
- **Metadata:** Default title template, OG tags, robots config
- **Font:** Inter from next/font
- **Imports:** `Nav`, `GridLines`, `Footer`, `ScrollProgress`

---

#### 2. **Homepage** (`/`) - `C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\app\page.tsx`
- **Type:** Server Component
- **Renders:**
  - Padded container with nav height offset
  - Hero statement: "Welcome, I'm a brand design director..." (AnimatedText, T2 size)
  - "FEATURED WORK" label (T1, uppercase, muted)
  - `EditorialGrid` with `GRID_ROWS_HOME` (5 rows of projects)
  - "View All Work" link → `/work`
  - Spacer before footer
- **Components Used:** `AnimatedText`, `EditorialGrid`
- **Data:** `GRID_ROWS_HOME` from projects.ts (5 rows: hero, 2fr/1fr, 1fr/2fr, hero, 2fr/1fr)

---

#### 3. **404 Not Found** (`/not-found.tsx`) - `C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\app\not-found.tsx`
- **Type:** Server Component
- **Renders:**
  - "404" heading
  - "This page doesn't exist." message
  - Back to Work link → `/`

---

#### 4. **About Page** (`/about`) - `C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\app\about\page.tsx`
- **Type:** Server Component
- **Renders:**
  - Hero statement: long bio with AnimatedText
  - Portrait placeholder (3/4 aspect, diagonal pattern, 260-400px responsive)
  - Bio section with structured data (Based, Experience, Expertise, Currently)
  - "Brands I've Worked With" section (12 clients in flex wrap)
- **Metadata:** Title "About", custom description
- **Components Used:** `AnimatedText`
- **Data:** `CLIENTS` array (Bloomberg, GLG, TIAA, etc.)

---

#### 5. **Work Archive** (`/work`) - `C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\app\work\page.tsx`
- **Type:** Client Component (`"use client"`)
- **State:** `filter` (category string, default "All")
- **Renders:**
  - `CategoryFilter` bar (horizontal pills, active state)
  - `EditorialGrid` with `GRID_ROWS_ALL` (7 rows, filtered by category)
- **Components Used:** `CategoryFilter`, `EditorialGrid`
- **Data:** `GRID_ROWS_ALL` (GRID_ROWS_HOME + 2 additional rows)

---

#### 6. **Project Detail** (`/work/[slug]`) - `C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\app\work\[slug]\page.tsx`
- **Type:** Server Component (async)
- **Dynamic Route:** `[slug]` parameter
- **Static Generation:** `generateStaticParams()` from all PROJECTS
- **Renders:**
  - Back link with chevron
  - Header: title + category/year MetaTags + description + sidebar metadata (Role, Year, Scope)
  - Hero image placeholder
  - Case study sections (if CASE_STUDIES[slug] exists) OR fallback gallery (2x2 asymmetric grid)
  - Prev/Next project navigation with labels
- **Components Used:** `MetaTag`, `PlaceholderImage`, `CaseStudySection`
- **Metadata:** Dynamic title + description from project

---

#### 7. **Thoughts Listing** (`/thoughts`) - `C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\app\thoughts\page.tsx`
- **Type:** Server Component
- **Renders:**
  - Header: "THOUGHTS ON DESIGN" label + statement with AnimatedText
  - Article list: bordered cards with number (01, 02...), date, title, excerpt
  - Top and bottom borders on all items
- **Components Used:** `AnimatedText`
- **Data:** `THOUGHTS` array (4 articles)
- **Metadata:** Title "Thoughts", custom description

---

#### 8. **Article Detail** (`/thoughts/[slug]`) - `C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\app\thoughts\[slug]\page.tsx`
- **Type:** Server Component (async)
- **Dynamic Route:** `[slug]` parameter
- **Static Generation:** `generateStaticParams()` from THOUGHTS
- **Renders:**
  - Back link to /thoughts with chevron SVG
  - Date (T5 small uppercase)
  - Title (responsive clamp size)
  - Horizontal rule divider
  - Article body: excerpt + placeholder full-text
- **Metadata:** Dynamic title + excerpt
- **Data:** Single `Thought` from THOUGHTS array

---

### COMPONENTS ARCHITECTURE

#### **Layout/Structure Components**

1. **Nav** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\Nav.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Client Component
   - **Purpose:** Fixed navigation bar
   - **Structure:** Grid 3-col (left links | center nameplate | right socials)
   - **Features:**
     - Active link detection (underline animation, scaleX)
     - Scroll state (blur background at scrollY > 20px)
     - Mobile menu (hamburger button, fullscreen overlay at ≤480px)
     - Social links (LinkedIn, Instagram)
   - **CSS Module:** `Nav.module.css`
   - **Hooks:** `usePathname`, `useState`, `useEffect`

2. **Footer** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\Footer.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Client Component
   - **Purpose:** Footer with CTA block, weather widget, socials
   - **Features:**
     - "Let's Work Together" CTA link to /about (hover color change)
     - Email: hello@jaimeibrahim.com
     - Weather widget: Open-Meteo API (NYC: 40.7128, -74.006, Fahrenheit)
     - Inline SVG icons: LinkedIn, Instagram (16x16)
     - Copyright bar with branding + optional weather display
   - **CSS Module:** `Footer.module.css`
   - **Hooks:** `useState`, `useEffect`

3. **GridLines** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\GridLines.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Server Component
   - **Purpose:** Background structural grid (7 vertical lines)
   - **Positions:** 0%, 16.67%, 33.33%, 50%, 66.67%, 83.33%, 100%
   - **Features:**
     - Fixed container, mirrors content maxWidth + padding
     - Optional animation: `scaleY(0→1)` staggered 60ms per line
     - Color: `rgba(0,0,0,0.055)`, 1px width
     - z-index 0, pointer-events none
   - **CSS Module:** `GridLines.module.css`

4. **ScrollProgress** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\ScrollProgress.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Client Component
   - **Purpose:** Fixed top scroll progress bar
   - **Features:**
     - 2px height, text color opacity 0.15
     - `scaleX` animation: 0 to scroll percentage
     - Hides below 1% scroll
   - **Hooks:** `useState`, `useEffect`

---

#### **Content/Grid Components**

5. **EditorialGrid** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\EditorialGrid.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Client Component
   - **Purpose:** Asymmetric editorial grid layout (Gretel NY pattern)
   - **Grid Types:**
     - `hero` → `1fr`
     - `wide-narrow` → `2fr 1fr`
     - `narrow-wide` → `1fr 2fr`
     - `triple` → `1fr 1fr 1fr`
   - **Features:**
     - Renders GridCard for each project in rows
     - Category filtering: remaps rows, converts triple to wide-narrow if filtered, removes empty rows
     - Responsive: CSS Module handles mobile collapse
   - **Props:** `rows` (GridRow[]), `filterCategory` (default "All")
   - **CSS Module:** `EditorialGrid.module.css`

6. **GridCard** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\GridCard.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Client Component
   - **Purpose:** Linkable grid card (project thumbnail)
   - **Features:**
     - PlaceholderImage with clip + scale wrappers (hover zoom)
     - Optional text block: title + description + elevator metatags
     - Image-only hover overlay (shows title on hover if no text)
     - MetaTags for category + year (elevator animation on hover)
   - **Props:** `project`, `showText`, `height`
   - **CSS Module:** `GridCard.module.css`
   - **Subcomponents:** `PlaceholderImage`, `MetaTag`

7. **PlaceholderImage** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\PlaceholderImage.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Server Component
   - **Purpose:** Colored placeholder until real images
   - **Features:**
     - Colored background (project.color)
     - Diagonal stripe pattern overlay
     - Bottom-left label (project title)
   - **Props:** `color`, `title`, `height` (default 380), `style`
   - **CSS Module:** `PlaceholderImage.module.css`

8. **MetaTag** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\MetaTag.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Server Component
   - **Purpose:** Pill-shaped category/year tag
   - **Features:** Background #E0E0DC, text #555555, 12px/400 weight, 5px 12px padding, 4px radius
   - **Props:** `label` (string)
   - **CSS Module:** `MetaTag.module.css`

---

#### **Interaction/Animation Components**

9. **AnimatedText** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\components\AnimatedText.tsx`)
   - **Type:** Client Component
   - **Purpose:** Line-by-line text reveal animation
   - **Features:**
     - Splits text into ~2 lines (word-wrap aware)

    - **Type:** Client Component

### UTILITY LAYER

#### **Hooks** (`C:\Users\User\JaimeIbrahim\src\lib\hooks.ts`)

1. **useInView(options)**
   - IntersectionObserver wrapper

   - Options: `threshold` (default 0.15), `rootMargin` (default "0px 0px -10% 0px")
   - Used by: `AnimatedText`, `CaseStudySection`

2. **useMouse(ref)**
   - Tracks mouse position within element (normalized 0-1)
   - Returns: `{ x, y }`
   - (Currently unused in current codebase)

3. **useScrollProgress()**
   - Calculates scroll percentage (0-1)
   - Returns: number
   - (Currently unused; ScrollProgress component implements inline)
